Slop Colors · Beta

Colour picker, palette generator and contrast checker

Pick colours from pictures, make palettes and check contrast. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

Slop Colors has these main features: Eyedropper with a magnifier, and the main colours of a picture; Harmonies, tints, shades and a 50 to 950 ramp. It opens Any image.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Slop Colors

  • Check colour contrast against WCAG
  • Pick colours from a picture
  • Generate a colour palette from one colour
  • Convert HEX to RGB, HSL, OKLCH or CMYK
